name: DEVOTIONCAGE
source:
You install a dating app hoping to meet new people—maybe even find love—only to match with someone who will change your life forever… and never let you go...

[From [url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/devotioncage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你装了个交友软件，希望能认识些新朋友，说不定还能找到爱情。结果，你匹配到了一个将永远改变你人生的人…而且，这个人永远也不会放你走…
